title: Grayton Beach “Grateful 2BN Grayton” 433 Defuniak Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Less than two-minute walk to beach- Private lagoon-style pool with sitting spa**Pool heating is available for $55 per day**- 5 King beds- 6 adult bikes- 4 Parking spots- Multiple balconies- Rooftop porch with Gulf view- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover Grateful 2BN Grayton, a delightful 6-bed, 4.5-bath residence in Grayton Beach accommodations for 14 guests. Revel in Gulf views from the rooftop porch, unwind in the private pool with a sitting spa, and enjoy the charm of multiple balconies. Step into the beach-inspired entryway leading to one of the three living rooms, two king guest bedrooms with a shared bathroom, leads out to the pool deck. The second floor features an open kitchen, living, and dining area leading to a balcony overlooking the pool, along with a bunk room and a king guest bedroom with a shared bath complete this level. The third floor boasts a sitting area with a wet bar. Completing the bedrooms are two primary bedrooms, each with a private bathroom. Cap off the experience on the rooftop deck perfect for sunset celebrations.Included 6 adult bikes make exploring Grayton Beach a breeze.
